title: QMMH/Tšepong health workers’ salary-grievance strike with reported picketing (Jan/Feb onset disputed)
location: Queen ‘Mamohato Memorial Hospital/Tšepong, Maseru; exact public picket site not established.
scope: Work stoppage at QMMH/Tšepong with reported picketing. The first physical public assembly and whether this is the same action described as beginning in January remain unresolved.
organizer: Not established. The DDPR says the continuing action was allegedly led by the Lesotho Nursing Association, but its January onset account may or may not describe this same episode.
participants_original: SABC reports that more than 300 health workers had been picketing. A search-only secondary report says non-nursing support staff joined on February 15.
threshold_50_evidence: Suggestive but not conclusive: the SABC report says more than 300 health workers had been picketing, without stating whether that number attended one gathering at the same time. Exact picket dates and site are not established; retain threshold as pending.

start_date.summary: Contemporary SABC, Sunday Express and Netcare accounts give February 1; VOA says the nurses had been striking for two weeks on February 15. The later DDPR report instead says the continuing Tšepong strike began sometime in January. The State Department report search excerpt gives February 1–March 11 but was not read. February 1 is a reported strike start, not a verified first public picket date.

end_date.summary: SABC reports an interim court interdict and expected return to work; the State Department search excerpt dates the strike to March 11. Neither establishes the last physical public picket, so end date remains unknown.

location.summary: The sources associate the workers with QMMH/Tšepong in Maseru. No consulted account identifies the exact place where public picketing occurred.

scope.summary: Reports describe a QMMH/Tšepong staff strike and picketing. Whether every cited group participated in one action and when the first public gathering occurred remain unresolved.

organizer.summary: DDPR retrospectively alleges Lesotho Nursing Association leadership for an action said to have started sometime in January; continuity with the February reports is uncertain.

demands.summary: Reports describe salary structure review/parity, outstanding COVID-19 payments and incentives. Sunday Express frames the parity demand as directed to government; Netcare describes a prior government undertaking under the PPP. Netcare’s statement is an attributed company account.

participants.summary: SABC reports more than 300 workers had been picketing, with no simultaneous-count clarification. The secondary WSWS search excerpt says support staff joined February 15; that body was not read. The government’s later 276 nurse staffing figure is not used as an event crowd count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The reported “more than 300” picketing figure suggests the 50-person threshold, but does not establish attendance at one public gathering at one time.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; no event-specific evidence in consulted material.

state_response.summary: SABC reports a Labour Court interim interdict. That court action does not map to the seven coded response fields; accommodation, arrests, beatings, crowd dispersal, ignoring, killings and shootings remain unknown.

notes: Provisional cross-month lead. Multiple contemporary accounts place strike onset on February 1, while DDPR says “sometime in January”; do not resolve ownership or assume that strike onset equals first public assembly. The >300 figure is not treated as a simultaneous turnout count. A State Department search excerpt reports a March 11 strike boundary, but its full text was not read and it does not establish the end of public picketing. The court interdict is noted but not recoded into a response category.
open_questions: Does DDPR describe this same workplace action, an earlier stage, or a separate dispute? Which month owns the episode?
Did at least 50 people attend one public picket at the same time, and where and on what date?
What was the last physical public picket date, distinct from strike or court-order dates?
Were support-staff actions part of this same episode?
Do any of the seven coded state-response or protester-violence fields have event-specific evidence?
